page_title: BAY 2-0 MON | Bayern Munich v B. Monchengladbach 10/05/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' Sven Jablonski is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+4' Bayern Munich take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

90+3' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads inside the right post, but Jonas Omlin shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him.
90+3' The referee allows time for a substitution. Harry Kane will be replaced by Gabriel Vidovic (Bayern Munich).
90+2' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) is shown a yellow card by the referee for making a challenge on his opponent, but he looks angry with the decision.
90+2' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) fails to time his run beyond the last defender and the linesman makes a good call by signalling for offside after seeing the whole situation unfold.
90' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
90' 2 - 0 Goal! Leroy Sane shows great vision to find Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) with a cheeky pass inside the box, and his first-time shot is precise and sails into the bottom left corner. 2:0.
89' Kevin Stoger (B. Monchengladbach) shows too much aggression during an attacking move and ends up fouling his opponent.
84' Here is a change. Thomas Muller is going off and Vincent Kompany gives the last tactical orders to Serge Gnabry (Bayern Munich).
84' The current number of shots on goal is 7:5.
84' Substitution. Rocco Reitz makes his way off the pitch and Florian Neuhaus (B. Monchengladbach) comes on as his replacement.
83' Raphael Guerreiro comes off the pitch to be replaced by Joao Palhinha (Bayern Munich).

82' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and smashes a glorious looking effort towards the bottom left corner, but Jonas Omlin thwarts him with a great two-handed save.
82' The attendance for today's match is 75000.
81' Tim Kleindienst (B. Monchengladbach) runs onto a lofted ball into the box, but hits a weak shot towards the middle of the goal that is easily dealt with by Manuel Neuer.
79' Tomas Cvancara (B. Monchengladbach) receives a great pass inside the box and misses a golden chance. The goalkeeper pulls off a stunning save.
76' Substitution. Franck Honorat will be replaced by Tomas Cvancara (B. Monchengladbach).
76' Gerardo Seoane has decided to make a change. Kevin Stoger (B. Monchengladbach) replaces Robin Hack.
76' Today's match ends for Philipp Sander who will be replaced by Alassane Plea (B. Monchengladbach).

75' A nice sequence of play ends with a shot by Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) from the edge of the box. The effort, however, is towards the middle of the goal where Jonas Omlin easily catches the ball.
69' Bayern Munich fail to score from a corner as Jonas Omlin (B. Monchengladbach) leaps to collect the ball.

69' Thomas Muller (Bayern Munich) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition. The referee points to the corner flag and Bayern Munich will take a corner.
67' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Bayern Munich.

64' A neat pass is well received by Aleksandar Pavlovic (Bayern Munich), who is lurking on the edge of the box and strikes the ball towards the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper makes an incredible save to block his shot.
63' Vincent Kompany has decided to substitute Josip Stanisic and he is replaced by Aleksandar Pavlovic (Bayern Munich).
62' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) will replace Kingsley Coman.

60' A cross following the corner kick finds its way to Rocco Reitz (B. Monchengladbach) inside the box and he manages to steer it to the left side of the target. He is about to start celebrating a goal, but Manuel Neuer makes a save in the nick of time and maintains the current score.
60' The linesman points to the corner flag, B. Monchengladbach are going to take it.

59' A short through ball almost allows Tim Kleindienst (B. Monchengladbach) to get in a good shooting position, but he loses it to one of the defenders. B. Monchengladbach have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
59' B. Monchengladbach can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
58' A nice individual effort by Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) comes to nothing as his shot is blocked on the edge of the box by a defender.
56' Now B. Monchengladbach have a corner.
53' Raphael Guerreiro (Bayern Munich) takes a shot after receiving a good pass, but his effort from the edge of the box goes just over the crossbar.
50' Sven Jablonski shows a yellow card to Julian Weigl (B. Monchengladbach) for his blatant foul.
49' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from B. Monchengladbach comes to nothing.
48' B. Monchengladbach have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

48' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. The ball goes out for a corner. B. Monchengladbach can continue in their attacking effort.
46' Thomas Muller (Bayern Munich) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
46' Gerardo Seoane prepares a substitution. Nico Elvedi is replaced by Joe Scally (B. Monchengladbach).
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+1' The match has reached half-time.

44' What a save from Manuel Neuer! Tim Kleindienst (B. Monchengladbach) jumps high to meet a cross and glances a promising header from close range, but the goalkeeper pulls off a brilliant stop to keep it out.
42' Thomas Muller (Bayern Munich) plays a lovely through ball to Harry Kane, but he can't beat Jonas Omlin and loses the ball.
41' Fabio Cristian Chiarodia (B. Monchengladbach) leaps like a salmon and powers a header in at goal from the corner, but his close-range effort is poor and goes way over the bar.
40' The ball goes out of play. B. Monchengladbach are awarded a corner kick.
40' Robin Hack (B. Monchengladbach) gets inside the box and tries to beat Manuel Neuer with a measured shot into the bottom left corner, but the keeper is equal to the effort and makes a fine save.
39' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 8:3.
37' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) latches on to a through ball inside the box, but one of the defenders steps in with a timely interception. It could have been a great chance otherwise.
31' 1 - 0 Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) scores with a bullet of a header that goes into the top left corner!
29' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) reacts well to latch onto a rebound inside the box, but his shot is well blocked.
29' Bayern Munich force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
26' Lukas Ullrich (B. Monchengladbach) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat.
23' Corner kick. B. Monchengladbach will have an opportunity.

22' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) receives a clever long through ball and finds himself in a promising position inside the box, but the defence is alert to the danger and clears. The referee blows his whistle, B. Monchengladbach are awarded a corner kick.
22' Bayern Munich keep possession of the ball with some short passes, waiting for the moment to hit the opposition swiftly on the break.

16' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) rises high to head a nice lofted cross towards the middle of the goal. Unfortunately for him, his close-range effort lacks pace and Jonas Omlin makes a comfortable save.
10' B. Monchengladbach failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
10' The corner is swung in but B. Monchengladbach can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

8' Stefan Lainer (B. Monchengladbach) had a good chance to change the score. He ran towards the goal and unleashed a shot from just outside the penalty area which went towards the top left corner, but the goalkeeper was ready and made an amazing save.
6' Thomas Muller (Bayern Munich) attempts to find Leon Goretzka, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
6' Konrad Laimer (Bayern Munich) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross.
5' Stefan Lainer (B. Monchengladbach) tackles a bit over-zealously and Sven Jablonski blows for a foul. Bayern Munich have been awarded a free kick.
5' The Bayern Munich players are exchanging short passes in an attempt to create a shooting opportunity.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Bayern Munich will kick the game off.
